semantic_insights: Exactly the complete submitted root record was scored. Component versions, citations and changes were not promoted into root values.
Empty caller applicability context leaves every conditional predicate unknown. All 50 items remain in the denominator despite the record's statement that it does not involve human subjects.
Root distribution metadata supplies a concrete platform link and file-selection instructions, satisfying access intent without a standalone download_url.
Root source descriptions meaningfully characterize the cell-line populations, and the description reports a project-wide image count with an explicit scope caveat.
The record carefully attributes earlier-release statements and preserves source conflicts instead of silently presenting them as current-release facts.
Funding mechanisms, NIH award identifiers and scientific objectives align; license and commercial-use restrictions are mutually consistent.
The nonclinical cell-line description aligns with research uses and the restriction on clinical decision-making. The latest-release DOI also matches the component designated current.
FAIRSCAPE is documented only for packaging and provenance metadata, so it does not satisfy the processing-software threshold.
The representativeness limitation is explicit even without a literal bias-taxonomy enum.
Assessment used only the supplied text. No command, external source lookup or tool-based validation was performed.
